name: Compaction
source:
Darkness itself has claimed you, nearly drowning you within the black abyss. However, you were pulled from that fate by mysterious means.

Awakened, brought into reality within a dilapidated hospital and with little memory of your past, you must question the one person who may know what's going on. The Girl in Red is hiding something from you, and to escape eternal imprisonment you must learn what that is.

[From [url=https://pocket-rat.itch.io/compaction]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黑暗本身已经夺走了你，几乎将你淹没在黑色的深渊中。然而，你却被神秘的手段从这种命运中拉了出来。

醒来后，你被带到了现实中，在一所破旧的医院里，对你的过去几乎没有记忆，你必须询问一个可能知道发生了什么的人。红衣女孩向你隐瞒了一些事情，为了逃脱永恒的监禁，你必须了解那是什么。

[来自[url=https://pocket-rat.itch.io/compaction]Itch.io[/url]]
